name: replicate
description: Run and integrate cloud machine learning models through the Replicate platform — search the model catalog, create and poll predictions, cancel stuck jobs, and chain image, video, audio, and language models together via a single MCP toolset.

interface.shortDescription: Run cloud ML models (image, video, audio, language) through the Replicate platform.
interface.longDescription: The Replicate skill exposes the community `mcp-replicate` MCP server as a single Fractal toolset. It lets the agent discover models via semantic search, inspect input/output schemas and version hashes, create long-running predictions, poll them to completion, cancel stuck runs, and chain multiple models together — all powered by the public Replicate catalog of open-source ML models. Requires a `REPLICATE_API_TOKEN` from replicate.com/account/api-tokens. Billed by GPU seconds, not by API call, so the skill includes rules to cancel unneeded predictions and avoid retry storms.
defaultPrompt: Use the Replicate skill whenever the task involves running a hosted machine learning model — image generation, upscaling, background removal, speech-to-text, text-to-video, or any model from the public Replicate catalog.
Always call `get_model` first to retrieve the exact version hash and input schema before creating a prediction, and pass that hash (not the model name) so the result is reproducible.

Prefer `create_and_poll_prediction` for short jobs and the non-blocking `create_prediction` + `get_prediction` loop for long-running ones. Cancel predictions you no longer need — Replicate bills by GPU seconds.
